fusions.name: Stamping Hop
fusions.desc: Your landing deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, and you heal for 10% of the damage dealt. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Ridden Down
fusions.desc: You leap up to 7 tiles onto the target and strike it 3 times, each strike dealing 6 damage. It is left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and [Fatigued] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Easy Canter
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4s after you use it.

fusions.name: Never Winded
fusions.desc: When you run out of stamina, you regain 20 stamina. Once every 30 seconds.
